statements.impact_statement: Applies only to the CI-built, unmodified SearchMeld image identified during this run. All shipped wget calls use literal loopback HTTP health URLs with proxies disabled; the bundled handlers never redirect or include attacker-controlled URL data. This is not a BusyBox package fix and does not cover arbitrary operator wget commands or custom proxy/health handlers. Owner: SearchMeld maintainers. Re-review before 2026-10-06 UTC and whenever these call paths, packages or image assumptions change. Evidence and limits: docs/security-review.md#busybox-applicability.
